sheet.title: Fish Bouillabaisse-Tasting Menu
sheet.replaces: The Redfish Véronique (d-s1bqzuks) as the third course of the dinner tasting; the redfish moves to the past menu items.
chefFacts: Bouillabaisse is a traditional French fish stew usually served with crusty bread and a rouille
Rouille is a thick garlicy Provencal French sauce made from olive oil egg yolks and breadcrumbs, saffron. It means Rust in French
sheet.note: As printed, spelling included (garlicy, Provencal without its cedilla, Alum). The sheet prints no price, fish, recipe or method.
